description: The theatrical advance screening of episodes 1–3 of BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War - The Calamity, held prior to their regular television broadcast. The presentation covers the opening of the fourth and final cour of the Thousand-Year Blood War adaptation and is not a standalone animated film. The international theatrical release additionally featured behind-the-scenes material and an interview with creator Tite Kubo and members of the production staff.
